text:
maria: FYI PhotonApps is hitting a sharp spike of 503/504s on hosted inference during streaming sessions starting ~2026-03-15T22:10Z. They say p95 latency jumps then SDK retries, which is driving unexpected billing. Sample request_id=ph-req-9f3a

Logs we grabbed from the edge/gateway around the spike:
```
edge-gw: conn=0x7f3 stream reset, RST_STREAM(2) code=0x1
upstream: 503 Service Unavailable "upstream service temporarily unavailable"
gateway: 504 read timeout after 30s
kernel: tcp_reset_from_peer
```

Customer SDK: rwd-js@1.6.2 using http2 streaming. They open ~30 concurrent streams, each streaming partial tokens and sending an app-level heartbeat every 10s. Repro steps from customer (they provided):
1) POST /v1/chat/stream with streaming enabled
2) keep the stream open, send heartbeats from client every 10s
3) after ~20-40s some streams hit RST_STREAM / 503 and client retries automatically

Observed locally: once several streams stall (client not draining frames fast enough) we see flow-control stalls -> gateway triggers resets; downstream returns 503. Can someone triage root cause and recommend a temporary mitigation for the customer? @sam @leo :eyes:

sam: Acknowledged. Can you paste a short tail of the L7 trace for one of the request_ids and confirm region? Also is PhotonApps on hosted multi-tenant or a reserved pool?

maria: Trace link: https://logs.internal/rw/trace/ph-req-9f3a (private). They're on hosted multi-tenant (not Dedicated). Edge was us-west-2 for these failures. Here's a trimmed L7 snippet:
```
[usw2][edge-gw] accept stream, id=12345
[usw2][edge-gw] stream stalled: tx window exhausted, awaiting WINDOW_UPDATE
[upstream][model-eval] drop conn, upstream closed with ECONNRESET
[edge-gw] report upstream 503 to client
```

leo: Looks like http2 flow-control/window updates not arriving fast enough because the client isn't reading frames quickly (heartbeats but not draining response frames). If the client sends heartbeats but blocks reading, edge's per-conn window hits zero -> RST or upstream close. Quick mitigations:
- Ask customer to disable streaming for now (non-streaming fallback reduces long-lived connections)
- Or increase edge keepalive/window settings temporarily (we can bump window/timeout)
- Add a per-tenant concurrent-stream cap so they don't open 30+ long-lived streams at once

ingrid: I'll pull the gateway traces and propose a temporary config change for the edge. Two immediate actions I can do: bump idle read timeout to 90s -> currently 30s, and apply a per-tenant concurrent-stream limit of 50 connections in the ingress LB. That should reduce resets and throttling while we investigate deeper.

support-bot: incident-bot created INC-4321 for thread 4072000000 (priority: P2)

sam: I ran a quick repro script locally that opens 30 http2 streaming connections in parallel (attached snippet) and saw identical RST_STREAM responses after ~25-40s under constrained read throughput. Reproducer notes: rwd-js@1.6.2 default streaming uses a small internal buffer; if the app doesn't drain the Readable stream promptly, the socket stalls.

maria: Customer comms: they want ETA and whether we can avoid a rollback. They have live users impacted. Can we give a short customer-facing status update?

ben: Draft for customer (short):
"Thanks — we see intermittent 503/timeout errors affecting streaming sessions. We're applying a temporary ingress config change to reduce connection stalls and adding a per-tenant limit to prevent retry storms. We recommend switching to non-streaming calls while we complete the mitigation; we'll follow up with a timeline within 2 hours."

maria: sending that now to PhotonApps (I'll include the workaround to disable streaming and a short code snippet).

ben: Approved. @ingrid can you confirm when the ingress tweak and tenant cap are live? After that we'll monitor for error-rate drop before telling customer to re-enable streaming.

ingrid: Applied changes at 2026-03-15T22:37Z: idle read timeout -> 90s, per-tenant concurrent streaming cap -> 50. I also pushed a temporary routing rule that will prefer smaller model variant for tenants exceeding 40 concurrent streaming sessions.

leo: Good. After the cap we should see fewer RST_STREAMs from the edge. I'll watch the stream-reset metric and p95.

support-bot: Monitoring alert: ERR_STREAM_RESET rate decreased by 60% in us-west-2 (last 15m) — alert status: resolved

maria: Customer updated: PhotonApps switched to non-streaming fallback and reported immediate reduction in errors. They're keeping streaming disabled for the next 24h while we do a root-cause deep-dive. Thanks all for the quick triage :sparkles:
